messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — Presidents' Day (US) lands on next cycle's Wed bridge window (our biweekly train). I propose shifting this train one day earlier to Tue so ENG has normal coverage. Thoughts?

 tom: I can cover Tue. Any impact on cutoff? We have a feature branch targeting Wed.

 anil: If we move, cutoff needs to be Tue 10:00 PT not Wed. That means we need earlier cherry-picks for release/1.4.3.

 sasha: We're mid-review on #4512; I can expedite. Can you confirm version bump and changelog expectations?

 maria: Yes — bump 1.4.2 -> 1.4.3 (patch). Changelog should call out batching KV fix + SSO regression fix. I'll add a short blurb under /docs/release-notes/1.4.3.md.

 jen: I'll update the calendar invite/bridge owner rotation and notify support. @leo can you be bridge lead Tue?

 leo: happy to, +1. Also we should run canary with dedicated pool — @anil please coord.

 anil: will do. Pushing canary tomorrow EOD. Also note merge queue will need to be paused for ~30m during branch cutover.

 release-bot: Proposed schedule updated: train moved to Tue 2026-03-03 08:00 PT. Cutoff: Tue 2026-03-03 10:00 PT. Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.

 tom: :thumbsup: 

 sasha: :thumbsup: done. quick changelog snippet below — please paste into release-notes:

 ```
- Fix: KV cache eviction causing duplication under heavy batching (fixes #4568)
- Fix: SSO token expiry mismatch causing 401s on warm start
```

 maria: added. Also FYI cherry-pick commands below for anyone doing manual merges:

 ```
git checkout release/1.4.x
git cherry-pick -x abcdef12
git push origin release/1.4.x
```

 Pause MQ: `./scripts/pause-merge-queue.sh`

 deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: branch freeze will be enforced at Tue 2026-03-03 10:00 PT. Auto-fallback policy will point to model-variant v1 if deploy fails.

 leo: I'll watch the bridge and call the rollback if p50 latency > 200ms.

 jen: Calendar updated and ICS sent to #eng-release-cadence. Support notified.

 maria: Thanks team — if no objections by EOD PST, I'll finalize the move and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
